_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); machinery and engines signals

pit_profile.why: 'Caterpillar is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1); 'Caterpillar products and product support services are sold worldwide into a variety of highly competitive markets'; 'The demand for our products and services tends to be cyclical and can be significantly reduced in an economic environment characterized by higher unemployment, lower consumer spending, lower corporate earnings and lower levels of government and business investment.' and 'The energy and mining industries are major users of our products, including the coal, iron ore, gold, copper, oil and natural gas industries.' (Item 1A): the 10-K calls the demand for its own products cyclical (BKR's 'Our business is cyclical'), so CYCLICAL from the FY2010 10-K; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: 'Caterpillar is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1); 'Caterpillar products and product support services are sold worldwide into a variety of highly competitive markets'; 'The demand for our products and services tends to be cyclical and can be significantly reduced in an economic environment characterized by higher unemployment, lower consumer spending, lower corporate earnings and lower levels of government and business investment.' and 'The energy and mining industries are major users of our products, including the coal, iron ore, gold, copper, oil and natural gas industries.' (Item 1A): the 10-K calls the demand for its own products cyclical (BKR's 'Our business is cyclical'), so CYCLICAL from the FY2010 10-K; no disruption theme is live for it. cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.93x; +14% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.56; conservative 2yr +18%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -61.5%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-2.3%/yr (FY13 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +20.7%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +84.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CAT (retrospective, 2013-03-01) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.93x (85.8% downside to Bear $13 / +92.6% upside to Bull $176) | Adj composite 1.50 vs market 2.06: gap -0.56 [OVERVALUED] | +14% above the EPP floor $80 (10x FY13E $8.00) | Conservative 2-yr case: +18.5% total (+9.3%/yr) | At 11.4x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $121 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; Machinery sales -5.8% in Q4 2012, forward revenues -8.9% to +3.2% (FY13 sales and revenues guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
